meta.name: The Imperishable Brahman
meta.outline: Verses 1–4: Arjuna's seven questions, and Krishna's short answers; 5–8: what a person remembers at death decides where they go, so remember Krishna always; 9–13: how the yogi leaves the body, with Om; 14–16: Krishna is easy to reach for the devoted, and for them there is no rebirth; 17–22: the day and night of Brahma, and what lies beyond them; 23–28: the two paths, of light and of smoke.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम
words: and what is called the realm of beings
what is called the realm of the gods
verses.tr: Arjuna asked: Krishna, what is that Brahman? What is the inner self, and what is karma? What is meant by the realm of beings, and what by the realm of the gods?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
words: who is the lord of sacrifice here, and how
and at the time of death
how are you to be known
verses.tr: Who is the lord of sacrifice in this body, and how is he here? And how are people with self-control to know you at the time of death?

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: Brahman is the supreme, which never perishes
one's own nature is called the inner self
verses.tr: Krishna said: Brahman is the supreme, which never perishes. A being's own essential nature is called the inner self. The creative act that brings beings into existence is called karma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the realm of beings is whatever perishes
and the cosmic Person is the realm of the gods
I myself am the lord of sacrifice
O best of those who have a body (Arjuna)
verses.tr: The realm of beings is everything that perishes. The realm of the gods is the cosmic Person. And the lord of sacrifice, here in this body, is I myself, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः
words: and at the time of the end
there is no doubt about this
verses.tr: Whoever leaves the body at the time of death remembering me alone comes to my state. There is no doubt about this.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्
words: one leaves the body at the end
to that very state one goes
having always been absorbed in it
verses.tr: Whatever a person thinks of when leaving the body at the end, Arjuna, that is what the person reaches, having been absorbed in it all along.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with mind and intellect given to me
you will come to me alone
verses.tr: So remember me at all times, and fight. With your mind and intellect given to me, you will come to me without doubt.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with a mind trained by steady practice
verses.tr: With a mind trained by steady practice, one that does not wander elsewhere, a person who keeps thinking of the supreme divine Person reaches him, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Think of him as all-knowing and ancient, the ruler, smaller than the smallest and the supporter of all, whose form is beyond thought, bright as the sun and beyond all darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: and with the strength of yoga
fixing the breath of life fully
सः तं परं पुरुषम् उपैति दिव्यम्
that person reaches the supreme divine Person
verses.tr: Whoever remembers him so at the time of death, with a steady mind, full of devotion and the strength of yoga, with the breath of life held firmly between the eyebrows, reaches that supreme divine Person.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: which the knowers of the Vedas call imperishable
which seekers free from attachment enter
they live a life of self-restraint
verses.tr: I shall tell you in brief of that goal which the knowers of the Vedas call imperishable, which seekers free from attachment enter, and for which people live a life of self-restraint.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च
words: closing all the gates of the body
and holding the mind in the heart
placing one's breath of life in the head
verses.tr: Closing all the gates of the body, holding the mind in the heart, raising the breath of life to the head, and established in yogic concentration,

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्
words: the one syllable Om, which is Brahman
verses.tr: whoever leaves the body saying the one syllable Om, which is Brahman, and remembering me, reaches the highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः
words: with the mind on nothing else
who remembers me constantly, every day
for him I am easy to reach
for that yogi who is always united with me
verses.tr: For the yogi who remembers me constantly, every day, with a mind on nothing else, and who is always united with me, I am easy to reach, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the home of sorrow, which does not last
the great souls do not get
verses.tr: Having come to me, the great souls are not born again into this passing home of sorrow, for they have reached the highest perfection.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
words: all the worlds, up to the world of Brahma
verses.tr: All the worlds, Arjuna, up to the world of Brahma, are places one returns from. But for one who comes to me, there is no rebirth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: those who know that a day of Brahma
and his night, ending after a thousand ages
those people know day and night
verses.tr: Those who know that one day of Brahma lasts a thousand ages, and that his night lasts a thousand ages too, truly know what day and night are.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: when the night comes they dissolve
verses.tr: When that day comes, all visible things come forth from the unseen. When the night comes, they dissolve back into that same unseen.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते
words: this very same multitude of beings
coming into being again and again, dissolves
and comes forth when day comes
verses.tr: This same multitude of beings comes into existence again and again, Arjuna. It dissolves helplessly when night comes, and comes forth again when day comes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति
verses.tr: But beyond this unseen there is another unseen existence, which is eternal. It does not perish when all beings perish.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
words: it is called the unseen and the imperishable
they call it the highest goal
on reaching which they do not return
verses.tr: It is called the unseen and the imperishable, and it is said to be the highest goal. Those who reach it do not return. That is my supreme home.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया
words: is reached by devotion to him alone
by whom all this is pervaded
verses.tr: That supreme Person, Arjuna, within whom all beings live and who fills all of this, is reached by devotion given to him alone.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ
words: that time I shall tell you
verses.tr: Now I shall tell you, Arjuna, of the times at which yogis who depart do not return, and the times at which they do return.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः
words: the six months of the sun's northern course
verses.tr: Fire, light, day, the bright fortnight of the moon and the six months of the sun's northern course: those who know Brahman and depart by this path go to Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the six months of the sun's southern course
verses.tr: Smoke, night, the dark fortnight and the six months of the sun's southern course: the yogi who departs by this path reaches the light of the moon, and returns.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते
words: these two paths, the bright and the dark
are held to be the world's eternal paths
by one a person goes and does not return
by the other one returns again
verses.tr: These two paths, the bright and the dark, are held to be eternal in this world. By one a person goes and does not return; by the other, one comes back again.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन
verses.tr: No yogi who knows these two paths is ever confused, Arjuna. So be steady in yoga at all times.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु च एव दानेषु
in the Vedas, sacrifices, disciplines and gifts
whatever reward of merit is promised
and reaches the supreme, first home
verses.tr: The yogi who knows this goes beyond all the rewards promised for studying the Vedas, for sacrifices, for self-discipline and for giving, and reaches the supreme, original home.
